description: Operator view of the platform: which services are reporting, their CPU, memory and threads, Python gRPC client traffic, the host (CPU, memory, disk, network, load) and VictoriaMetrics. Replaces Service Health Overview, Fleet Overview, Host Metrics and VictoriaMetrics (#1427).

panels.description: Application services that pushed process metrics in the last few minutes (count of jobs with process_cpu_seconds_total). Expected on the default stack: game-coordinator, menu, audio, controller-manager, rust-hid, connect-proxy, agent (7), plus pairing-daemon on the Pi and python-hid when its profile is enabled. The table to the right shows which ones.
panels.title: App services reporting

panels.description: Pull-scraped targets (flagd, envoy, VictoriaMetrics, the collector itself) whose last scrape failed (up == 0). OTLP-push services have no up series; see 'App services reporting'.
panels.title: Scrape targets down

panels.description: Controllers the controller-manager tracks as connected (sum of controller_connected).
panels.title: Controllers connected

panels.description: Games currently running, real and shadow (one game_active series per live game, labels game_kind, game_id).
panels.title: Live games

panels.description: Failed outbound gRPC calls and streams from the Python services in the last 5 minutes (grpc_client_errors_total, #1353). Counts errors at call setup, at the end of a unary call and while a stream is read, from the Python services' channels and the controller-manager HID adapters; a cancel by the caller is not counted. Excluded: the Go agent's game-runner client and connect-proxy (#1426).
panels.title: gRPC client errors (5m)

panels.description: Resident memory of every process selected by the Service variable.
panels.title: Service memory (total)

panels.description: Every process that reports process metrics, with live CPU %, resident memory and thread count per job. This is the liveness view for OTLP-push services, which have no up series. Job names carry the namespace prefix on VictoriaMetrics (joustmania/, infrastructure/, observability/).
panels.title: Services (CPU / memory / threads)

panels.description: Scrape status of the pull-scraped targets (collector prometheus receivers: flagd, envoy, VictoriaMetrics, the collector's own :8888).
panels.title: Scrape targets

panels.description: CPU utilisation per process (rate of process_cpu_seconds_total over 5m, percent of one core).
panels.title: CPU per service

panels.description: Resident memory per process (process_resident_memory_bytes).
panels.title: Memory per service

panels.description: OS threads per process (process_threads; goroutine-mapped threads for the Go services).
panels.title: Threads per service

panels.description: Outbound gRPC calls per second from the Python services, by callee service (count of grpc_client_request_duration_seconds).
panels.title: Client request rate by callee

panels.description: 95th percentile of outbound gRPC call duration, by callee service. A stream counts once, with its whole lifetime, when it ends (#1426).
panels.title: Client latency p95 by callee

panels.description: Failed outbound gRPC calls and streams per second, by callee service (grpc_client_errors_total, #1353). Counts errors at call setup, at the end of a unary call and while a stream is read, from the Python services' channels and the controller-manager HID adapters; a cancel by the caller is not counted. Excluded: the Go agent's game-runner client and connect-proxy (#1426).
panels.title: Client error rate by callee

panels.description: 99th percentile of outbound gRPC call duration, by callee service and method. A stream counts once, with its whole lifetime, when it ends (#1426).
panels.title: Client latency p99 by method

panels.description: Failed outbound gRPC calls and streams per second, by callee service, method and gRPC status code (grpc_client_errors_total). Counts errors at call setup, at the end of a unary call and while a stream is read, from the Python services' channels and the controller-manager HID adapters; a cancel by the caller is not counted. Excluded: the Go agent's game-runner client and connect-proxy (#1426).
panels.title: Client errors by method and code

panels.description: Share of CPU time not idle, averaged over all cores. Host metrics come from the collector's hostmetrics receiver (job host/node): CPU, memory and load every 1 min, disk, filesystem and network every 5 min.
panels.title: Host CPU

panels.description: Used memory as a share of used + free + buffered + cached (the slab states overlap with these and are left out). Host metrics come from the collector's hostmetrics receiver (job host/node): CPU, memory and load every 1 min, disk, filesystem and network every 5 min.
panels.title: Host memory

panels.description: Used space on / as a share of used + free (reserved blocks left out). Host metrics come from the collector's hostmetrics receiver (job host/node): CPU, memory and load every 1 min, disk, filesystem and network every 5 min.
panels.title: Root filesystem

panels.description: 1-minute load average of the host. Host metrics come from the collector's hostmetrics receiver (job host/node): CPU, memory and load every 1 min, disk, filesystem and network every 5 min.
panels.title: Load average (1m)

panels.description: Host CPU time by state, percent of one core summed over all cores.
panels.title: CPU by state

panels.description: Host memory by state, stacked (used, buffered, cached, free add up to total).
panels.title: Memory

panels.description: Host load average over 1, 5 and 15 minutes.
panels.title: Load average

panels.description: Host network throughput per interface (loopback, veth, docker and bridge interfaces excluded by the receiver).
panels.title: Network I/O

panels.description: Host disk throughput per device (loop devices excluded).
panels.title: Disk I/O

panels.description: Used space per mounted filesystem (tmpfs, overlay and /run, /sys, /proc left out).
panels.title: Filesystem usage

panels.description: Host swap by state, stacked (used + free = total swap), summed over swap devices. From the collector hostmetrics paging scraper (system_paging_usage_bytes, job host/node), collected every 5 min. Steadily growing used swap means the host is short of memory.
panels.title: Swap

panels.description: Rows (samples) VictoriaMetrics stores per second, by ingestion protocol (the collector writes with Prometheus remote write).
panels.title: Ingestion rate

panels.description: On-disk size of all VictoriaMetrics data (sum of vm_data_size_bytes over all parts). Retention is 7 days.
panels.title: Storage size

panels.description: Series in the VictoriaMetrics storage index (vm_cache_entries{type="storage/tsid"}). Per-game and per-controller series (game_id, serial labels) accumulate here, and memory grows with it under the 256 MiB container limit.
panels.title: Active time series

panels.description: Resident memory of VictoriaMetrics. The container limit is 256 MiB (docker-compose.yml).
panels.title: Memory (RSS)

panels.description: Free space on the volume that holds the VictoriaMetrics data.
panels.title: Free disk
